_source.note: An LJ/HJ/CO open is 3-bet by a seat behind; the opener folds, calls or 4-bets. 6-max cash, 100bb, no ante, pure (PTO), hand -> 0/1. Fold = neither 4Bet nor Call 3Bet. Call 5Bet<opener>vs<seat> splits the 4-bets: those that call a 5-bet jam are value, the rest bluffs. Sizing profile cash_default (source README): 2.5bb open; 3-bet IP 3x (7.5bb), OOP 5x (12.5bb); 4-bet IP 2x, OOP 2.5x, rounded. Open ranges are the Open<seat> keys already vendored in cash-100-pto.json. Same repo and caveats as cash-100-pto.json (licence unclear; personal use).
